Settings

Set up what the board shows and how the device behaves. Visited rarely, so it optimises for finding a setting and understanding it, not speed. Every change applies at once (no Save), except the destination schedule. Sections depend on the mode: Wall board or On the spot. On ≥700 px the content is a centred column (max 640 px); from 1000 px the board settings split into two columns, what the board shows and how the device behaves, mirroring the app's current tablet layout. A list/detail split was rejected: the sub-screens are short, one-off tasks, and a second pane would leave most of a wall display empty most of the time.

Data sources

Departures and routes come from Entur, the national registry of public transport in Norway. These companies share their timetables with it. If a company isn’t listed, PulseTransit can’t show its departures.
